roll.name: DATED-1
roll.source: Hughes, A.L.C., Gyllencreutz, R., Lohne, Ø.S., Mangerud, J. & Svendsen, J.I. (2016). The last Eurasian ice sheets — a chronological database and time-slice reconstruction, DATED-1. Boreas 45(1), 1–45. https://doi.org/10.1111/bor.12142
roll.changes: Changes were made: time-slice extents reprojected from north-pole Lambert equal-area to WGS84, simplified at 3 km and rounded to 0.01 degrees; the 27, 28–29 and 30–32 ka single extents are carried as most-credible; the 35–38 ka slice has only maximum and minimum; nothing else.

roll.name: PATICE
roll.source: Davies, B.J. et al. (2020). The evolution of the Patagonian Ice Sheet from 35 ka to the present day (PATICE). Earth-Science Reviews 204, 103152. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.earscirev.2020.103152
roll.data: Data for: The evolution of the Patagonian Ice Sheet from 35 ka to the Present Day (PATICE), Mendeley Data https://doi.org/10.17632/rjnw46vbdw
roll.changes: Changes were made: the Icesheet time-slice polygons (35, 30, 25, 20, 15, 13, 10, 5 and 0.2 ka) were reprojected from UTM zone 18S to WGS84, simplified at 1 km and rounded to 0.001 degrees; the margin-confidence lines and glacial lakes are not drawn; nothing else.
roll.note: Published CC BY-NC 3.0, and the author has given this map written permission to use it commercially. Professor Bethan Davies (Newcastle University) granted that permission by email on 19 October 2026, on the condition that the credit stays as it is. The published deposit is unchanged and anyone else taking it is bound by CC BY-NC 3.0; this grant sits beside the licence, not instead of it. Carried as a recorded licence debt from 2026-09-17 until 2026-10-20. Email on file with the founder.

roll.name: US Environmental Protection Agency
roll.source: US Environmental Protection Agency, Level III Ecoregions of the Conterminous United States, 2013-04-16, ecoregion "Mojave Basin and Range". Originator: US Environmental Protection Agency; access constraints None; use constraints None, with acknowledgement of the EPA requested. Public domain, 17 U.S.C. 105. Natural Earth has no Mojave polygon at all, so this one boundary comes from a second federal source rather than being hand-drawn; it is reprojected from USA Contiguous Albers Equal Area Conic to WGS84 and otherwise unaltered, and it takes the same margin fade as every other polygon here.
